svg.title: PB-HY-001 HYBRID paddle - general arrangement
svg.text: SCALE 1:2 · CF 4 / WAVE-RIB CORE 8 / CF 4 · CORE DETAIL: SHEET 3
ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES. DO NOT SCALE THE DRAWING. UNLESS STATED: LINEAR ±0.5, ANGULAR ±0.5°.
PROFILE SYMMETRICAL ABOUT THE CENTRE LINE. ALL ARCS TANGENT TO ADJOINING EDGES.
SANDWICH: CF FACE SHEET 4 + WAVE-RIB CORE 8 + CF FACE SHEET 4 = 16 ±0.3, UNIFORM OVER
BLADE AND HANDLE. BODY (SHEETS + CORE) FROM y = 5 TO THE TIP; GRIP BASE y = 0 … 5.
FACE SHEETS (2 OFF, IDENTICAL): WOVEN CARBON/EPOXY PLATE 4 THK, CUT TO PB-HY-001_profile.dxf,
RIB SUPPORT (CORE): 3D-PRINTED PA-CF, CLOSED FRAME 6, WAVE RIB λ18 / WALL 1.6 / LANDS 4.25,
SOLID TO y = 150 WITH 45° FLUTE RUN-OUT – SEE SHEET 3 (1- OR 2-PIECE PRINT).
BOND CORE TO SHEETS: STRUCTURAL EPOXY, ABRADED + PRIMED SURFACES, FILLET ALL LAND EDGES
GRIP: PRINTED PLA GRIP (ANY OF THE TEN REV-8 DESIGNS; DRAWN: CARBON MATRIX, 61 g), SLOT 30.2 × 16
× 130 DEEP, LOCKED BY A DIN 7984 M3 × 12 SCREW INTO AN M3 HEAT-SET INSERT – SEE PB-GR-002.
USA PICKLEBALL LIMITS: L + W = 580 ≤ 609.6 (24 in), L = 390 ≤ 431.8 (17 in), INCL. GRIP.
AN EDGE GUARD COUNTS TOWARDS THESE LIMITS (MARGIN 29.6).
MASS 802 g WITH THE GRIP, BALANCE POINT 230 FROM THE BUTT (FROM THE 3D MODEL).
GENERAL ARRANGEMENT · 390 × 190 × 16 mm · CF / WAVE-RIB SANDWICH
